title: KarveCaptionCorrections
description: Sparse ASR error corrections for display captions. Does NOT modify transcript.json.

source_word_start.description: Index of the first word in transcript.segments[].words[] to correct (0-based global word index).

source_word_end.description: Index of the last word to correct (inclusive). For single-word corrections, equals source_word_start.

original_text.description: The raw ASR text being corrected. Must match the concatenation of the source words.

replacement.description: Replacement words. Array length determines the replacement mapping: 1:1, N:1, 1:N, or N:M.

reason.description: Category of the ASR error. Must NOT be stylistic or grammatical.

confidence.description: Model confidence in this correction. Corrections below 0.7 are flagged for manual review.
